critical_code_review_comments: AskMLS.jsx heroQuote uses Date.now() day-index rotation — pure client-side, so different clients see the same quote same day; acceptable. Consider guarding against empty quotes array (already handled via early null return).
Home.jsx onCopy uses e.currentTarget inside setTimeout — after React re-render currentTarget may be null; the `if (e.currentTarget)` guard mitigates but consider capturing element in a local var.
Tailwind config still names tokens 'sage' and 'terracotta' despite semantic swap to gold/onyx-black — confusing for future maintainers. Rename tokens or add comment mapping.
server.py deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown (carryover from prior iterations).
Quote/Announcement models still use free-form strings for year_level/category — Literal/Enum recommended for stronger validation.
